benchmark_scope: Top-two margin GPU kernel microbenchmark only; no model server, vLLM integration, or end-to-end inference measurement.
notes: The GPU power and temperature readings were taken after the benchmark and are idle-time snapshots, not benchmark averages.
The H100 GPU was placed in US-CA-2 Secure Cloud. The local Windows compiler could not run because cl.exe was unavailable; the source was compiled successfully with the Pod's Linux nvcc.
The Pod was terminated after result capture; the final lifecycle read confirmed it no longer existed.
